note: No baseline has been recorded. This file is the shipped template. run_evals.py score reads recorded_at, sees null, prints 'no baseline recorded, run /hyperpower:eval --baseline first', and exits 3. Record your own with: run_evals.py score --run <run-dir> --record-baseline .hyperpower/evals/baseline.json. Do not edit a recorded baseline by hand.

schema.recorded_at: UTC timestamp the baseline was recorded, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. null means no baseline is recorded.
schema.condition: name of the condition whose rows were aggregated, for example candidate.
schema.cases_path: path to the cases.jsonl the rows were judged on.
schema.cases_sha256: digest of that file. score refuses to compare when it differs.
schema.rubric_sha256: digest of rubric.md. score refuses to compare when it differs.
schema.trials: trials per case in the recorded run.
schema.models: models.judgment and models.mechanical in force. Used by the public comparison clause.
schema.rows: the judged rows, each a [case_id, trial] pair. score refuses to compare an unpaired set.
schema.means: mean score per dimension, 1.00 to 5.00. All six dimensions, every one non-null in a recorded baseline.
schema.weighted: weighted mean, 1.00 to 5.00. The candidate must beat this, strictly.
schema.blockers: count of blocking findings in the recorded run.
schema.note: one line of provenance. Not read by any code.
